name: Steak au Poivre, Frites & Dressed Salad
description: Pan-seared ribeye with a brandy peppercorn cream sauce, crispy air-fryer chips and a lemon-Dijon dressed side salad.
instructions: Cook the frozen chips in an air fryer at 200°C for 20–25 minutes, shaking twice, until crisp, or follow the packet instructions.

Pat the ribeye dry and season generously with salt and 1 tsp coarsely cracked black pepper. Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a heavy frying pan over high heat and sear for 2–3 minutes on each side, adjusting for thickness and preferred doneness. Add 10 g butter for the final minute and baste, then rest the steak for 8 minutes.

Dissolve ¼ beef stock cube in 100 ml boiling water. Lower the pan to medium heat and cook the finely chopped shallot in the remaining 5 g butter for 2 minutes. Add 25 ml brandy and simmer for 1 minute, scraping up the browned bits.
Add the prepared stock and reduce by half. Stir in the cream, ½ tsp Dijon mustard and another ½ tsp cracked black pepper, then simmer gently for 2–3 minutes.
Whisk 1 tbsp lemon juice with ½ tsp Dijon mustard and 1 tbsp olive oil. Toss with the salad leaves, then serve beside the chips, rested steak and peppercorn sauce.
